findings.observation: Raw hip and after-reload PNGs show support skin arm and a cropped trigger-side arm. ADS sample06 has a clear sight aperture without an upper arm crossing it. After-reload framing visibly returns to the hip arrangement.
Lid is open and visibly hinged to receiver. Handling hand is outside the crop at06 and beside drum at08; exact off-crop contact is unverified.

Twin drum and belt/feed assembly accompany the handling palm through the visible excursion. No visible palm-to-drum gap requiring a contact offset appears in these inspected frames. Lid remains hinged to receiver while magazine rises; projected overlap at13/14 does not establish attachment to lid.

Drum returns beside receiver at18; handling hand is visibly withdrawn at19, consistent with release rather than a detached hand/belt defect. Recovery/closure continues at20/22. At25 lid is closed and support hand returns underneath; exact canonical return is established by separate after-reload PNG and oracle, not sample25 alone.
